title: Canonical scalar, tensor and direct-image comparisons at etale origins
statement: Let A and B be finite commutative rings, φ:A→B, and p:Z→Y a qcqs scheme morphism. Use the ordinary unbounded module-sheaf derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] and canonical site comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Write F for its intrinsic coefficient realization, U for exact scalar restriction [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction], S for derived scalar extension [lem-fix-proetale-scalar-mate-normalization], R_e for etale direct image and P for intrinsic pro-etale direct image. Define H(M)=M tensor_A^L B, q_M:F(H(M))≅USF(M) by the existing normalized scalar/tensor and site/scalar isomorphisms. For bounded-below E define b_E:F(R_e E)≅P(F(E)) by the included fixed counit mate [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate], followed by the section-normalized realization and direct-image comparisons. Define π_e:R_e(M) tensor B_Y→R_e(M tensor B_Z) to be the actual etale projection [def-kun-projection-formula-map] followed by the canonical coefficient pullback. These are exactly the eight constructions extracted, verbatim, from the proper scalar-isomorphism module; no data or signatures change.
